exposure: vaginal dinoprostone (PGE(2)) for induction of labor
cohort: 424 pregnant women undergoing induction of labor, including 47 with a previous cesarean section (TOLAC)
finding: Induction of labor with vaginal dinoprostone in women with a previous cesarean section was not associated with significantly worse obstetric or neonatal outcomes compared to women without a history of cesarean section.
mod_finding: Although not statistically significant, the percentage of cesarean sections was higher in the TOLAC group (44.7%) compared to the group without a history of cesarean section (31.6%).
